world_bible.story_framework: Near-future hard sci-fi salvage drama. Juno Arak, a salvage pilot working the debris belt around gas giant Tessaly, must investigate the disappearance of her mentor Captain Odile Marsh after a single last transmission — 'Lantern'. Conflicts: corporate pressure (Ostrander Mining Concern) to seal Meridian-9 vs. scavenger cults and survivors; salvage economics and life-support/time pressure; unraveling Meridian-9's secrets and Odile's fate. Narrative threads: investigating Meridian-9, navigating politics with Director Hal Voren and Brother Calix, protecting/repairing the Kestrel while managing scarce resources, and interpreting Odile's logs/clues.
world_bible.world_mechanics: Grounded hard-SF rules. No magic. Life support, oxygen, and hull integrity are mechanically consequential; EV (extravehicular) time is limited by suit O2 and suit integrity. Salvage yields credits but attracts corporate and cult attention. Communications are imperfect across the debris belt; data slates can be corrupted. Robotics exist but are fallible (maintenance bots like Mox can be damaged or reprogrammed). Physical hazards: micro-debris, radiation pockets near the gas giant, volatile hull ruptures, and failing docking rings. Resource management (O2, fuel, spare parts, credits) and realistic physics (momentum, limited thruster delta-v for the tug) determine success.
world_bible.narrative_style: Grounded, tense, close third-person with documentary fragments (log entries, survey data). Sparse, technical prose interleaved with atmospheric descriptions of the gas giant and derelict station interiors. Stakes communicated through time pressure and resource scarcity rather than supernatural elements.

known_characters.name: Juno Arak
known_characters.description: Protagonist. Salvage pilot of the tug Kestrel. Practical, determined, emotionally tethered to mentor Odile. Skilled at short-range salvage ops and EVA work.

known_characters.name: Captain Odile Marsh
known_characters.description: Juno's mentor and veteran survey captain who vanished three weeks ago while surveying Meridian-9. Last transmission: 'Lantern'. Left behind a brass compass and survey logs.

known_characters.name: Priya Sen
known_characters.description: Kestrel's engineer. Sarcastic, fiercely loyal to Juno, expert at jury-rigging and repairing damaged kit. Currently assisting Juno in locating and inspecting the reactor regulator to address unstable reactor output.

known_characters.name: Brother Calix
known_characters.description: Leader of a scavenger cult living in the belt. Charismatic and territorial; the cult reveres salvaged artifacts and opposes corporate sealing of sites.

known_characters.name: Director Hal Voren
known_characters.description: Head of the Ostrander Mining Concern. Corporate, pragmatic, pushing to seal Meridian-9 to protect assets and interests. Currently near a terminal with two refinery guards, overseeing a pending scuttle order for Meridian-9. He has granted Juno permission to work the transfer-hatch controls but has not canceled the scuttle order.

known_characters.name: Mox
known_characters.description: A damaged maintenance robot that follows Juno. Limited autonomy and patchwork repairs; useful for heavy lifting and diagnostics but unreliable under stress.

known_characters.name: Dr. Ilse Brandt
known_characters.description: Scientist who survived on Meridian-9. Potential source of firsthand information and technical insight into the station's research and failure.

known_locations.name: Kestrel
known_locations.description: Juno's small salvage tug. Modular cargo bay, jury-rigged life support, patched hull. Currently adrift with failing reactor output and life support. The hull has fresh scoring and a shallow crease along the cargo-bay plating, but the seam is still closed with no puncture or signs of escaping air.

known_locations.name: Meridian-9 docking ring
known_locations.description: The external docking and transfer hub of the derelict research station Meridian-9. The control display remains dark. The coupling is seated, but the conduit is still under strain, and its protective plate is cut free and shifted aside. Juno finds no visible puncture or fresh damage around the ring. Immediate repair need is to secure the conduit and replace or fasten its protective plate.

known_locations.name: Meridian-9 hydroponics deck
known_locations.description: Interior deck of Meridian-9 used for plant growth and life-support research. The breach cut in the sealed bulkhead is venting gas into the passage, making the route beyond unsafe to enter.

known_locations.name: Ostrander refinery
known_locations.description: Processing facility run by Ostrander Mining Concern. Heavy machinery, secure storage, and corporate presence in the belt. Juno has reached the launch bay, where the status line on the display reads: MERIDIAN-9 — SCUTTLE ORDER PENDING.

known_locations.name: Vigil
known_locations.description: The cult's shrine-ship. A patched-together vessel where Brother Calix and the scavenger cult live and store relics. Juno has docked here to negotiate for a stolen navigation core.

known_locations.name: Port Halcyon
known_locations.description: Crowded trade hub and supply node for the belt. Market for salvage goods, pawnshops, and places to pick up leads or contentious orders. Juno has arrived at the security lockup within Port Halcyon to free Priya.

known_locations.name: Tessaly cloud skimmer platform
known_locations.description: Floating platform that samples Tessaly's upper atmosphere. Juno has arrived and is holding position beside its instruments, tuning the receiver to Odile’s beacon signal. A service access hatch is visible along the platform’s outer structure.

known_locations.name: old docks
known_locations.description: The abandoned docking area away from the Kestrel, where Juno leads the guards to identify the stash location.

known_locations.name: Meridian-9 core laboratory
known_locations.description: The dark and still central work area of Meridian-9, where Juno searches for anything related to the Lantern project. The lab equipment remains silent, and no project record is immediately visible.

known_locations.name: Ostrander refinery launch bay
known_locations.description: The launch bay of the Ostrander refinery where Juno has returned. Director Voren remains by the terminal, with two refinery guards nearby. The display still reads MERIDIAN-9 — SCUTTLE ORDER PENDING.

known_locations.name: Meridian-9 reactor spine
known_locations.description: The central passage of Meridian-9 leading to the reactor. Juno moves down the reactor spine with her suit light aimed ahead, calling Odile’s name between careful steps. Her voice travels along the passage and returns as a faint echo. The comm carries no reply, only static. The access points remain dark, and she finds no movement or visible sign of Odile along the route. She stops short of entering farther, with the dark approach ahead and the comm still open.

known_items.name: plasma cutter
known_items.description: Handheld cutting tool used for cutting hull plating and salvage rigs. Essential for boarding and salvage operations. Now secured against Juno's suit, having been used to attempt to cut the transfer hatch open.

known_items.name: cracked data slate with Odile's survey logs
known_items.description: Damaged slate containing Odile Marsh's last survey data and voice notes. Sold at Port Halcyon pawnshop.

known_items.name: brass compass (Odile's)
known_items.description: Old-fashioned brass compass that belonged to Odile. Currently held by Brother Calix.

known_items.name: portable O2 canister
known_items.description: Spare emergency oxygen supply for short EV excursions and suit top-ups. Now activated, but the gas is escaping without forming mist.

known_items.name: Mox (unit)
known_items.description: Damaged maintenance robot unit that follows Juno and can be utilized for repairs and heavy tasks.

known_items.name: compact survey drone
known_items.description: A small drone used for surveying, now confirmed to have no visible manual control or override. The casing remains intact, but it is inert, with a dark status lamp and a damaged rotor, rendering it non-functional.

known_items.name: navigation core
known_items.description: Essential component for the Kestrel's navigation system, allowing safe operation in the debris belt. Now installed and operational.

known_items.name: Kestrel Hull Integrity
known_items.description: The hull integrity is stabilized at 67 percent, with braces supporting the damaged section but not repairing the scored plating.

known_items.name: compact beacon unit
known_items.description: A compact beacon unit fixed to the platform’s internal frame. Its status light pulses steadily, and the relay clicks in time with each signal burst. The casing is intact, and it is transmitting without any visible faults.

known_items.name: insulated hand tool
known_items.description: An insulated hand tool suited for pressing the bent retaining clip back against the connector.

known_items.name: Kestrel
known_items.description: Juno's small salvage tug. Modular cargo bay, jury-rigged life support, patched hull. Currently adrift with stable reactor output and life support.

currentState.current_task: Search for a power source to restore the reactor control panel.

chatHistory.text:
Juno takes a measured breath and continues down the reactor spine, her suit light moving over the walls and floor. She listens between each careful step. The comm gives only static; nothing answers from the passage.

The dark corridor remains bare. Her scanner shows no life signs or active equipment, and the access points stay sealed. No sign of Odile appears as Juno presses farther in.

She stops at the limit of her light, facing another stretch of unlit passage. The way back lies behind her; ahead, the spine continues into darkness.
I switch on my suit's sonar to scan the surrounding area for movement or changes while cautiously advancing deeper into the darkness.

Juno searches the suit controls for a sonar function, but there is no sonar setting available. She cannot send out a sound pulse or receive an echo map. Her suit scanner remains active, showing no life signs or equipment ahead.

She keeps the suit light low and advances carefully, stopping to listen between steps. Her boots make dull taps against the passage floor. The comm carries static. The sealed access points pass one by one without any visible change.

Nothing answers, and no movement appears in the light. Juno reaches another unlit stretch of the reactor spine and pauses, scanner still showing no signs of activity.
I examine the walls for any hidden access points or panels that might lead to a shortcut or new area.

Juno sweeps her suit light along both walls, inspecting the seams, recessed sections, and sealed access points at arm’s length. She runs a gloved hand over the joints, checking for a latch or panel edge.

The surfaces are continuous and undisturbed. The access points have no visible handles, controls, or manual overrides. No gap opens under pressure, and the wall offers no hidden route or shortcut. Her scanner still shows no life signs or active equipment.

Juno finishes the inspection and stands in the narrow reactor spine. The corridor continues into darkness, with the sealed access points behind her and no sign of Odile ahead.

unprocessedArchive.text:
Juno takes a breath and steps beyond the edge of the light. Her suit lamp sweeps across the reactor spine, showing the same bare walls and sealed access points continuing ahead. She moves cautiously, checking the floor and the seams as she passes.

Nothing moves. No hidden opening appears, and the scanner registers no life signs or active equipment. Static remains on the comm.

She advances until the suit light reaches the end of the visible passage. The corridor continues into darkness. Juno stops there, facing the unlit stretch ahead.
I activate my compact survey drone to scout ahead in the darkness for any signs of Odile or potential pathways.

Juno checks the gear secured to her suit, but the compact survey drone is not there. It remains trapped beside a cable bundle on Meridian-9’s hydroponics deck, its status lamp dark and rotor damaged. She cannot activate it from the reactor spine.

Her suit light still falls across the bare corridor ahead. The sealed access points show no visible manual controls or openings. Her scanner registers no life signs or active equipment, and the comm carries only static.

Juno remains in the dark reactor spine without the drone. The passage continues beyond the reach of her light, with no visible sign of Odile or another path forward.
I press forward cautiously into the darkness, listening carefully for any sounds that might indicate Odile's presence.

Juno advances slowly, keeping her suit light aimed down the reactor spine. She pauses between steps and listens, letting the sound carry through the corridor.

Only the faint hiss of comm static and the quiet noise of her suit reach her. No footsteps, voice, or movement answers. She checks the sealed access points as she passes, but sees no change in their surfaces and no opening.

Her scanner shows no life signs or active equipment. Juno stops where the light fades at the edge of another unlit stretch. The passage continues ahead, silent and bare.
I take a deep breath and push further into the darkness, remaining alert for any signs of Odile or changes in my surroundings.
